design.notes: Approved Research Journal screens: parchment #F7F4EE, ink #20354B, copper #A65C36 and sage #E5EEE8; dark navy #14212E. Serif editorial headings, paper strip, numbered questions, citation tiles, rectangular composer and Discuss/Library/Saved navigation.

steps.text: Request an email link and retain its per-request PKCE verifier on the server.
Open the link in the same browser; exchange its code and share the session with other tabs.
Land directly in Discuss and resume the last selected paper.
Choose a text PDF under 50 MB, inspect its selection and upload it.
Check server processing progress, see readable failures or connection errors, and retry a failed processing job. Completion enables questions.
Ask a question after the paper is ready; show pending work, retain the question on errors or timeouts, and retry with genuine citations.
Inspect the answer's source excerpts and retrieve its PDF.
Bookmark and annotate a finding, then find it under Saved.
Search papers in Library and return to their discussion.
Open Saved and filter findings awaiting review.
Check a finding's source, mark it reviewed and retain its review date across reloads.
Download a local JSON export containing findings, sources, annotations and review status without sign-in credentials.
Choose Try sample workspace or open the sample link without an account.
Select an included question, read its prepared answer and inspect genuine source excerpts.
Save, annotate, mark reviewed, reload and export sample findings locally.
Explicitly open the private workspace for authenticated uploads and live questions.

promises.text: Migrate version 2 research records without deleting original storage; retain prior questions, answers, citations and drafts.
Live answers and excerpts come from the private backend. Sample answers are clearly labelled prepared examples with included source excerpts; no live AI generation is claimed for the sample.
Question failures keep the draft; sign-out hides account research without deleting it.
A failed status refresh is shown as stale status, never as a confirmed PDF-processing failure. Check status gives feedback even when the status has not changed.
Question failures remain visible beside the retained draft. Upload and question timeouts have separate recovery instructions; new questions are deferred while search services warm up.
Copy schema 3 records into schema 4, preserve existing answers, sources, bookmarks, annotations and drafts, and retain the original storage value.
Review status and export work locally. Exports include only saved findings and never session tokens, account email or user identifier.
The sample creates no authenticated session, makes no backend requests, and uses its own storage key. It cannot read or overwrite private account records or export account credentials.
